title: Inside 'The Morgue' at The New York Times

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，帮助您理解世界，充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受特惠，网址为 nytimes.com 加上 subscribe。

sentences.en: Rachel, where are we going today?
sentences.zh: 蕾切尔，我们今天要 去哪里？

sentences.en: We're going to the New York Times morgue, which I've never been to and I've worked here 12 years.
sentences.zh: 我们要去《纽约时报》的资料室，我从来没去过，虽然我在这里工作了12年。

sentences.en: What is a morgue for those of us who don't know?
sentences.zh: 对于我们这些不知道的人来说，资料室是什么？

sentences.en: Okay, well, I think it is the place where they keep all kinds of clippings from old New York Times stories as well as books that reporters have relied on for literally decades.
sentences.zh: 好的，嗯，我认为那是他们保存各种老《纽约时报》报道剪报以及记者们依赖了整整几十年的书籍的地方。

sentences.en: Okay, and I see today that you are holding a book yourself.
sentences.zh: 好的，我看到你今天自己也拿了一本书。

sentences.en: You want to tell us about it?
sentences.zh: 你想给我们讲讲吗？

sentences.en: Yes, okay, so maybe close to 12 years ago, I myself was a retail reporter who needed to learn about Ralph Lauren and I borrowed a book and Jeff, who we're going to go meet,
sentences.zh: 是的，好吧，大概在12年前，我自己曾是一名零售记者，需要了解拉尔夫·劳伦，我借了一本书，而我们要去见杰夫，

sentences.en: who runs the morgue, told me explicitly, like, you have to return this and I never did.
sentences.zh: 他管理资料室，明确告诉我，比如，你必须还这本书，而我从来没还。

sentences.en: So we're going to go return this book and see how mad he is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要去还这本书，看看他有多生气。

sentences.en: Did you read it?
sentences.zh: 你读了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Very nice, all right.
sentences.zh: 很好，好吧。

sentences.en: Does he know you have it?
sentences.zh: 他知道你有这本书吗？

sentences.en: He doesn't know, so he can capture his real reaction.
sentences.zh: 他不知道，这样就能捕捉到他真正的反应。

sentences.en: He won't even recognize us, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我想他甚至认不出我们。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Rachel.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是蕾切尔。

sentences.en: I'm back with another episode for subscribers.
sentences.zh: 我带着订阅者的另一集回来了。

sentences.en: Hi, Jeff.
sentences.zh: 嗨，杰夫。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: It's been a little while.
sentences.zh: 好久不见了。

sentences.en: I'm Rachel, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是蕾切尔，我不知道。

sentences.en: This week, I am taking you somewhere pretty interesting.
sentences.zh: 这周，我带你们去一个相当有趣的地方。

sentences.en: You want to head that away?
sentences.zh: 你想往那边走吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Jeff, I've got something for you.
sentences.zh: 杰夫，我有东西要给你。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Okay, I don't know if you remember this, but like, maybe 10 years ago or so, I can't remember
sentences.zh: 好的，我不知道你是否还记得这个，但是，差不多10年前左右，我不记得

sentences.en: exactly when, I borrowed a book from the morgue about Ralph Lauren, and I never returned it.
sentences.zh: 具体是什么时候了，我从资料室借了一本关于拉尔夫·劳伦的书，而且我从来没有还。

sentences.en: Oh, I know that book.
sentences.zh: 哦，我知道那本书。

sentences.en: You know that?
sentences.zh: 你知道？

sentences.en: Do you recognize this?
sentences.zh: 你认得这个吗？

sentences.en: Have you been like, where has this been?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过，这东西跑哪儿去了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Do I owe you like a late fee or something?
sentences.zh: 我是不是欠你什么滞纳金之类的？

sentences.en: Yeah, right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I thought you'd be so happy to have it back.
sentences.zh: 我还以为你把它要回来会很高兴呢。

sentences.en: It's deep underneath Midtown Manhattan, where there's an archive owned by the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 它在曼哈顿中城地底下深处，那里有一个《纽约时报》拥有的档案馆。

sentences.en: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: It's filled with millions and millions of newspaper clippings and books about pretty much any subject you can think about, going back to the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 里面装满了数以百万计的报纸剪报和书籍，几乎涵盖你能想到的任何主题，可追溯到19世纪。

sentences.en: And it's kind of a secret.
sentences.zh: 而且这有点像个秘密。

sentences.en: So we're walking into the building right now, where the morgue is.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在正走进资料室所在的建筑。

sentences.en: It's a building right next to the New York Times building.
sentences.zh: 它就在《纽约时报》大楼旁边。

sentences.en: And Jeff is signing us in.
sentences.zh: 杰夫正在为我们登记。

sentences.en: I knew about this place, but I'd never been myself.
sentences.zh: 我知道这个地方，但我自己从没去过。

sentences.en: It's run by a man named Jeff Roth, the only person who really understands how it works and where everything is.
sentences.zh: 它由一个名叫杰夫·罗斯的人管理，他是唯一真正了解它如何运作以及所有东西在哪里的人。

sentences.en: I just want to note, by the way, that we're going downstairs.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我只想指出我们正在下楼。

sentences.en: The morgue is located in the basement.
sentences.zh: 资料室位于地下室。

sentences.en: We're deep enough that I can hear the new subway that goes by.
sentences.zh: 我们深得甚至能听到新地铁驶过的声音。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Yeah, so that's pretty deep.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以这相当深。

sentences.en: Recently, Jeff and I met up, along with Daily producer Rochelle Bonja, so he could show us around and I could return that book.
sentences.zh: 最近，我和杰夫以及《每日新闻》制作人罗谢尔·邦贾见面，这样他可以带我们四处看看，而我也能把那本书还了。

sentences.en: This is three levels down.
sentences.zh: 这是地下三层。

sentences.en: And this is actually the old Herald Tribune's building, as in the New York Herald Tribune and the International Herald.
sentences.zh: 这其实是旧先驱论坛报的大楼，也就是纽约先驱论坛报和国际先驱报。

sentences.en: Today, on subscriber-only episode of The Daily, a tour of what we call the morgue.
sentences.zh: 今天，在《每日新闻》的仅限订阅者收听的节目中，参观我们所谓的资料室。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, you can see here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，是的，你可以在这里看到。

sentences.en: Come, come, come this way for a second.
sentences.zh: 来，来，往这边走一下。

sentences.en: All of those boxes.
sentences.zh: 所有这些箱子。

sentences.en: All of these bankers boxes?
sentences.zh: 所有这些银行纸箱？

sentences.en: Yeah, there are about 1,300 of them that are coming.
sentences.zh: 对，大约有1300个要运来。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: And I can see, how many are here?
sentences.zh: 我能看到，这里有多少？

sentences.en: There's like all these brown stacks and stacks, like eight boxes high.
sentences.zh: 就像所有这些棕色的堆叠，大约有八个箱子那么高。

sentences.en: So, I'm breaking down the pallets, 54 boxes on each.
sentences.zh: 所以，我正在拆托盘，每个托盘54个箱子。

sentences.en: So, these are coming from the University of Texas in Austin.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些是从德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校运来的。

sentences.en: So, they had them there and I boxed them up and sent them down there, I think, 27 years ago, and then recently they asked if we wanted to use them again, and so we said yes, but
sentences.zh: 所以，他们把它们放在那里，我把它们装箱并运到那里，我想，是27年前，然后最近他们问我们是否想再次使用它们，所以我们说是的，但是

sentences.en: I only had room for, well, originally I thought I only had room for 900 boxes, so I was going to get rid of the rest, but since the stuff was so great, I decided to bring 1,300.
sentences.zh: 我只有空间，嗯，我最初以为我只有900个箱子的空间，所以我打算处理掉剩下的，但既然这些东西太棒了，我决定把1300个都带来。

sentences.en: So, it's subjects and states and countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是按主题、州和国家分类的。

sentences.en: So, it's kind of anything and everything.
sentences.zh: 所以，有点包罗万象。

sentences.en: Can I just pull out a random thing to see what it is?
sentences.zh: 我能随机抽出一件来看看是什么吗？

sentences.en: Okay, so, all right, I'm going to pull out this packet.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么，好吧，我要抽出这个包裹。

sentences.en: I'm unwinding some twine that's attaching these clips together.
sentences.zh: 我正在解开把这些剪报绑在一起的麻绳。

sentences.en: I'm going to read you a few headlines from some of these kind of worn pieces of paper that have been cut out from newspapers.
sentences.zh: 我要给你们读几条头条新闻，来自这些从报纸上剪下来、有些破损的纸片。

sentences.en: So, this first one, let's see here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这第一条，让我们看看。

sentences.en: And so, here are what we call the rag edition, which is made out of, literally made out of cloth.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我们所谓的棉布版，它是用，字面意思是用布做成的。

sentences.en: Wait, the article's not made out of cloth?
sentences.zh: 等等，文章不是用布做成的吧？

sentences.en: Well, it's like, they call it linen.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像是，他们叫它亚麻布。

sentences.en: And so, you would have, so here, feel it.
sentences.zh: 所以，你会拥有，所以来，摸摸看。

sentences.en: It's like it was made yesterday.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是昨天刚做的一样。

sentences.en: It does not feel like a rag.
sentences.zh: 摸起来一点也不像抹布。

sentences.en: This definitely feels like a paper.
sentences.zh: 这绝对摸起来像纸。

sentences.en: No, it's paper, but it's fine paper.
sentences.zh: 不，它是纸，但它是优质纸。

sentences.en: And so, we used to print a rag, it's called the rag edition of the Times.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们过去常常印刷一种棉布版，被称为《泰晤士报》棉布版。

sentences.en: It says, June 1st, 1950, the headline of what I'm holding says, AT&T, Vail Awards for Courage
sentences.zh: 上面写着，1950年6月1日，我手里拿的头条新闻写着，AT&T，维尔勇气奖

sentences.en: Go to Four.
sentences.zh: 授予四人。

sentences.en: God, I have no idea what that is.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我完全不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 对，我完全不知道。

sentences.en: And so, here's August 1950.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是1950年8月。

sentences.en: It's literally, what we're looking at is one inch of text.
sentences.zh: 字面意思，我们看到的是一英寸长的正文。

sentences.en: The headline is, Saved by Telephone, printed on sort of a yellow piece of paper that is pasted onto what looks like a white note card, almoSt.
sentences.zh: 头条新闻是，电话救命，印在一张有点发黄的纸上，这张纸几乎是贴在看起来像白色便条卡的东西上。

sentences.en: August, August 1st, 1950.
Pauline Meinskow, 22 years old, a telephone operator, saved the life of a woman who was knocked unconscious when a china closet fell on her.
sentences.zh: 22岁的电话接线员保利娜·明斯科夫救了一位女性的命，当一个瓷器柜倒下时，她被砸得失去了知觉。

sentences.en: In her fall, Mrs. Hiram K.
sentences.zh: 在摔倒时，海勒姆·K·摩西

sentences.en: Moses, 44, swept a telephone off a table.
sentences.zh: 夫人（44岁）把桌上的电话扫了下去。

sentences.en: Ms. Meinskow heard a groan over the wire and notified the police.
sentences.zh: 明斯科夫女士通过电话线听到了一声呻吟并通知了警察。

sentences.en: She will never be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 她将永远被铭记。

sentences.en: She will never be forgotten.
sentences.zh: 她将永远被铭记。

sentences.en: Well, and so, here's the thing, is that, so if you looked for this, let's say the family looked for it on the internet, they wouldn't find it, because it was killed after the first
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以，情况是这样的，就是说，如果你找这个，比方说家属在互联网上找它，他们是找不到的，因为它在第一版

sentences.en: edition.
sentences.zh: 之后就被撤掉了。

sentences.en: And so, they wouldn't find it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们找不到它。

sentences.en: But it was here.
sentences.zh: 但它在这里。

sentences.en: Can you imagine if they listened to this, the subscriber-only episode about the morgue?
sentences.zh: 你能想象如果他们听到这个，关于资料室的仅限订阅者的节目会怎样吗？

sentences.en: Should we go into the actual morgue?
sentences.zh: 我们要不要进真正的资料室去？

sentences.en: I don't think I've been to this morgue, Jeff.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我没来过这个资料室，杰夫。

sentences.en: This does not look familiar to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我看开说一点也不熟悉。

sentences.en: How long have you been down here?
sentences.zh: 你在这里待了多久了？

sentences.en: Since 2007.
sentences.zh: 自2007年以来。

sentences.en: And just to describe what this room looks like.
sentences.zh: 顺便描述一下这个房间长什么样。

sentences.en: So, not only is it just full of boxes and filing cabinets and books everywhere, but the filing cabinets...
sentences.zh: 所以，不仅到处都是箱子、文件柜和书，而且文件柜……

sentences.en: This room weighs about 700,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 这个房间重约70万磅。

sentences.en: Wait, this room weighs?
sentences.zh: 等等，这个房间重？

sentences.en: I've never heard somebody say that a room weighs...
sentences.zh: 我从来没听谁说过一个房间有多重……

sentences.en: Well, when we moved from 43rd Street, movers get paid on how much stuff weighs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们从43街搬家时，搬运工是按东西的重量来收费的。

sentences.en: And so, we had to weigh each cabinet, and there's hundreds of cabinets in here, and each cabinet weighed between 400 and 600 pounds.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须称量每个柜子，这里有几百个柜子，每个柜子的重量在400到600磅之间。

sentences.en: So, there's a lot of cabinets here.
sentences.zh: 所以这里有很多柜子。

sentences.en: How many cabinets?
sentences.zh: 有多少个柜子？

sentences.en: I think 600, and then probably thousands of boxes.
sentences.zh: 我想有600个，然后大概有几千个箱子。

sentences.en: And then I'm adding another 1,300 boxes to this.
sentences.zh: 然后我还要往这里增加1300个箱子。

sentences.en: And so, it weighed 600,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 所以它重60万磅。

sentences.en: But I think I've added about 100,000 to it since we moved in in 2007.
sentences.zh: 但我想自从我们在2007年搬进来以后，我又往里面增加了大约10万磅。

sentences.en: And the walls are also decorated with all kinds of New York Times memorabilia.
sentences.zh: 墙上也装饰着各种《纽约时报》的纪念品。

sentences.en: Like, I see a poster that says, where the New York Times is made.
sentences.zh: 比如，我看到一张海报上面写着，《纽约时报》是如何制作的。

sentences.en: And this is...
sentences.zh: 而这个是……

sentences.en: Oh, and here's something from A.M.
sentences.zh: 哦，这里有来自A.M.

sentences.en: Rosenthal.
sentences.zh: 罗森塔尔的东西。

sentences.en: That was Abe Rosenthal, I presume.
sentences.zh: 我猜那是艾布·罗森塔尔。

sentences.en: One of the former executive editors of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》前执行主编之一。

sentences.en: Wait, actually, this is really moving.
sentences.zh: 等等，其实，这真的很感人。

sentences.en: Can I...
sentences.zh: 我能……

sentences.en: I just want to read the whole thing just so we have it.
sentences.zh: 我只想把整段读出来，这样我们就有了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, it's A.M.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是A.M.

sentences.en: Rosenthal on the morgue.
sentences.zh: 罗森塔尔谈资料室。

sentences.en: The joy of it was that you would find what you did not know you were looking for.
sentences.zh: 它的乐趣在于，你会找到你并不知道自己在寻找的东西。

sentences.en: You would get an assignment, then go to the morgue to find out what you were going to report
sentences.zh: 你会接到一个任务，然后去资料室找出你要报道的内容

sentences.en: about, who the people were, what they had done, said, and thought, that had been printed in the paper.
sentences.zh: 关于那些人物是谁、他们做过什么、说过什么以及想过什么的内容，都曾被印在报纸上。

sentences.en: After reporting, but before sitting down to write, you would go back to the morgue and look at the clips again, relating them to what you had learned yourself.
sentences.zh: 在采访结束后、动笔写作之前，你会回到资料室再次查看这些剪报，将它们与你自己的了解联系起来。

sentences.en: You would spread the clips out on your desk, and almost always, before and after the reporting,
sentences.zh: 你会把剪报摊在桌上，几乎总是在采访前后，

sentences.en: you would find a clue, a piece of information that you did not know had existed, the pleasure of serendipity.
sentences.zh: 你会找到一条线索，一段你原本不知道存在的信息，这就是偶得珍宝的乐趣。

sentences.en: No morgue, no paper.
sentences.zh: 没有资料室，就没有报纸。

sentences.en: I did not know a reporter who did not understand that the morgue provided the memory and the history, not only of the subject, but of the paper itself.
sentences.zh: 我认识的记者都明白，资料室不仅为报道对象、更为报纸本身提供了记忆与历史。

sentences.en: And how could any paper live without its memory and its history?
sentences.zh: 没有了记忆和历史，任何报纸又该怎么生存呢？

sentences.en: That's really lovely.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And yeah, I think the thing here is that there's the serendipity of finding something that you
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得这里的关键在于，有一种意外发现的乐趣，就是你

sentences.en: just didn't know about, didn't know existed, and moving on from there and trying to figure out how it fits into, let's say, a story that a reporter's doing.
sentences.zh: 根本不知道它的存在，然后从这里出发，试着弄清楚它如何融入记者正在做的报道中。

sentences.en: And that would happen all the time.
sentences.zh: 这种事总是会发生。

sentences.en: So can you explain, what is this place?
sentences.zh: 那么你能解释一下，这是什么地方吗？

sentences.en: What is it for?
sentences.zh: 它是用来做什么的？

sentences.en: So the Times Morgue is where we store all the old stories and all the old pictures and various other things, parts of the book collection.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》资料室是我们存放所有旧报道、旧照片以及其他各种藏书的地方。

sentences.en: So the morgue itself dates pretty much from the late 1800s, starts being collected in uniform and codified about 1905.
sentences.zh: 所以资料室本身基本上可以追溯到19世纪末，大约在1905年开始进行统一收集和编目。

sentences.en: Our great former executive editor, Carr Van Ander, asks two boys, John Beacon and Thomas Bracken,
sentences.zh: 我们伟大的前执行主编卡尔·范·安德，让两个男孩，约翰·比肯和托马斯·布拉肯，

sentences.en: to start, and when I say boys, because back then the Times hired young boys who were, let's say,
sentences.zh: 开始着手。我说男孩，是因为当年《时报》雇用的都是很年轻的男孩，比方说，

sentences.en: 14 or 15 years old, and they started creating this collection.
sentences.zh: 14、15岁，他们开始创建了这个收藏。

sentences.en: It was a different type of coding system.
sentences.zh: 这是一种不同类型的编码系统。

sentences.en: They did things alphabetically corresponding to numbers than other newspapers.
sentences.zh: 他们用按字母顺序对应数字的方式来处理，这与别的报纸不同。

sentences.en: We were kind of specific that way.
sentences.zh: 我们在这一点上挺独特的。

sentences.en: So you have people and you have subjects.
sentences.zh: 所以你既有人物，也有主题。

sentences.en: So George Washington or the Emmys, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如乔治·华盛顿或者艾美奖。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so George Washington, you would look under W, George, and he'd have his folder.
sentences.zh: 对于乔治·华盛顿，你会在W字母下的乔治栏目里找到他的文件夹。

sentences.en: Fanciful characters have their folders.
sentences.zh: 虚构人物有他们的文件夹。

sentences.en: Famous racehorses have their folders.
sentences.zh: 著名的赛马也有它们的文件夹。

sentences.en: And so you have collections for biographical, as in people, and you have collections for subjects.
sentences.zh: 所以你既有传记类（即人物）的收藏，也有主题类的收藏。

sentences.en: And the subjects can range from countries and states to diseases, drugs.
sentences.zh: 主题的范围从国家、州到疾病、毒品不等。

sentences.en: And why is it called the morgue?
sentences.zh: 为什么它被称为“停尸房”（morgue）？

sentences.en: Why is it called the morgue?
sentences.zh: 为什么它被称为“停尸房”？

sentences.en: It's not exactly 100%, but supposedly.
sentences.zh: 虽然不是百分之百确定，但据说是因为——

sentences.en: So if you wrote a story, we'd call it, okay, so the story is a dead story.
sentences.zh: 如果你写了一篇报道，我们会说，好吧，这篇报道是一篇“死稿”。

sentences.en: Now put it in the dead drawer.
sentences.zh: 现在把它放进“死稿抽屉”里。

sentences.en: So once there were a number of drawers, it became a morgue, like the drawers in a morgue.
sentences.zh: 因此，一旦有了许多抽屉，它就变成了“停尸房”，就像停尸房里的抽屉一样。

sentences.en: And so that's how, the origin of the word supposedly.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个词的据传起源。

sentences.en: And that's a word that was being used probably from the late 1800s on.
sentences.zh: 这个词大概从19世纪末开始就被使用了。

sentences.en: Should we put my book back?
sentences.zh: 我们要把我的书放回去吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, let's put that back.
sentences.zh: 对，对，我们把它放回去。

sentences.en: Okay, so Rachel's book goes where I have all the fashion books.
sentences.zh: 好吧，瑞秋的书要放到我放所有时尚书籍的地方。

sentences.en: So if I crank this shelf.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我转动这个书架。

sentences.en: Wait, so there's an actual crank attached to this filing cabinet that you're turning?
sentences.zh: 等等，这个文件柜上居然连着一个你在转的手柄？

sentences.en: Yeah, so there's an actual crank attached.
sentences.zh: 对，上面连着一个实际的手柄。

sentences.en: And truthfully, what's being moved is probably about, I'd say, 20,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 说实话，正在被移动的东西大概有，我觉得有2万磅重。

sentences.en: Or maybe at least over 10,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 或者至少超过1万磅。

sentences.en: So we just saw you, as you cranked it, the entire wall of filing cabinets moved to create a new walkway for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们刚才看到，当你转动手柄时，整面墙的文件柜都移动了，为我们腾出了一条新通道。

sentences.en: Exactly, and here, I'll take the book.
sentences.zh: 没错，来，我拿着这本书。

sentences.en: And so this is a book on Ralph Lauren.
sentences.zh: 这是一本关于拉尔夫·劳伦的书。

sentences.en: So I have some of the culture section's fashion books.
sentences.zh: 所以我这里有文化版的一些时尚书籍。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're walking through this newly created walkway.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们正走过这条刚腾出来的通道。

sentences.en: So on my left are filing cabinets, on my right are filing cabinets.
sentences.zh: 所以我的左边是文件柜，我的右边也是文件柜。

sentences.en: And it goes up there, but I need my ladder.
sentences.zh: 它一直延伸到上面，但我需要我的梯子。

sentences.en: But I don't have my ladder right now, so I'll just put it over here for now.
sentences.zh: 但我现在没有梯子，所以暂时先把它放在这里。

sentences.en: But how will it ever find its way back?
sentences.zh: 那它以后要怎么找回原来的地方呢？

sentences.en: Oh, no, I have my ladder and I bring it, you know, I have the moving ladder and I bring it and I put it up there.
sentences.zh: 哦，不，我有梯子，我会把它拿来，你知道的，我有移动梯子，我把它拿来并放到那上面。

sentences.en: Do you have a filing system for knowing that Rachel returned her book after 12 years?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有一套归档系统，能知道瑞秋在12年后把书还了回来？

sentences.en: Uh, no.
sentences.zh: 呃，没有。

sentences.en: That's why you never try to get it back from me.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你从来没想过从我这里把它要回去。

sentences.en: Yeah, no.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: Okay, so just to describe this, so this is, we're looking at a, I'm 5'6 and these filing cabinets are about my height.
sentences.zh: 好吧，为了描述一下这里，我们看到的是——我身高5英尺6英寸，这些文件柜差不多有我这么高。

sentences.en: And then above them is probably another 5 feet or so.
sentences.zh: 而在它们上方可能还有大约5英尺高的空间。

sentences.en: Oh, more than that.
sentences.zh: 哦，不止。

sentences.en: More than 5 feet of books just piled high.
sentences.zh: 堆得高高的书超过了5英尺。

sentences.en: And so you're telling me that my book goes on the very top here where we cannot reach, so you've put it on top of another stack of books.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是我的书要放在最顶上我们够不到的地方，于是你把它放在了另一堆书的上面？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you will know that this is here.
sentences.zh: 而你会知道这东西在这里。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so what this is, is this is outside of the Times' Library books.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这个地方是在《时报》图书馆藏书之外的。

sentences.en: This is kind of my, so to speak, collection in the morgue of fashion books and books that deal with New York City and books that deal with architecture.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是，可以这么说，我在资料室里收集的时尚书籍、关于纽约市的书籍以及关于建筑的书籍。

sentences.en: Oh, this is so cool with the old New York and early photographs.
sentences.zh: 哦，这里有老纽约和早期照片，真是太酷了。

sentences.en: Can I see this?
sentences.zh: 我能看看这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 可以，可以，可以。

sentences.en: So that's Dover Publications book, the, yeah.
sentences.zh: 这是多佛出版社的书，那个，对。

sentences.en: This is like, there's like Jenga.
sentences.zh: 这就像是，就像叠积木一样。

sentences.en: If I pull one of these out, it's all going to fall on my head.
sentences.zh: 如果我抽出其中一本，全部都会砸到我头上。

sentences.en: Okay, here we go.
sentences.zh: 好啦，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: And so those are.
sentences.zh: 这些是——

sentences.en: These are black and white photos of New York.
sentences.zh: 这些是纽约的黑白照片。

sentences.en: Yeah, and so that's from the collection of New York Historical Society.
sentences.zh: 对，这是来自纽约历史学会收藏的。

sentences.en: This is so cool.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: How long has the New York Times had a morgue and how long have you worked at the morgue?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》有资料室多久了？你又在资料室工作了多久？

sentences.en: New York Times has had a morgue since the 1800s.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》从19世纪就开始有资料室了。

sentences.en: I'd say the earliest clip files that I have are the late 1870s.
sentences.zh: 我想我这里最早的剪报档案可以追溯到19世纪70年代末。

sentences.en: My earliest advance obituary I just found was from 1899.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚找到的最早的生前预写讣告是1899年的。

sentences.en: An advance obituary, meaning an obituary written ahead of the person dying.
sentences.zh: 生前预写讣告，意思是在人去世前提早写好的讣告。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we have maybe 3,000 or 4,000 written.
sentences.zh: 对，所以我们大概写了3000到4000篇。

sentences.en: I think it's 3,000 or 4,000 written.
sentences.zh: 我想是3000或4000篇吧。

sentences.en: Probably another 3,000 or 4,000 that have to be written.
sentences.zh: 可能还有另外3000到4000篇有待撰写。

sentences.en: And so this was written in 1899.
sentences.zh: 这个是1899年写的。

sentences.en: It was a Civil War general from the Union Army, and he was also Speaker of the House.
sentences.zh: 他是一位联邦军队的内战将军，也是众议院议长。

sentences.en: Yes, and so we wrote it in 1899, and he lived into the 1930s, so he was pretty old.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在1899年写了它，而他一直活到了20世纪30年代，所以他非常长寿。

sentences.en: He was almost 100.
sentences.zh: 他将近100岁。

sentences.en: I was going to say, presumably that obit has been used by now.
sentences.zh: 我正想说，那篇讣告现在想必已经用过了。

sentences.en: Yes, and so as far as the morgue and how long it's been, yes, 1800s, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，至于资料室及其历史，是的，19世纪绝对是有的。

sentences.en: Maybe making it uniform and cataloging dates to about 1905.
sentences.zh: 也许将其统一并编目大约始于1905年。

sentences.en: And how long have you worked at the morgue?
sentences.zh: 你在资料室工作多久了？

sentences.en: I don't know, it's over 30 years now.
sentences.zh: 不知道，现在已经超过30年了。

sentences.en: But I mean, I got hired to do this.
sentences.zh: 不过我是被雇来做这个的。

sentences.en: So what did you see me doing today?
sentences.zh: 那你今天看到我在做什么？

sentences.en: Moving a bunch of boxes.
sentences.zh: 搬一堆箱子。

sentences.en: That's what I got hired to do, move a bunch of boxes.
sentences.zh: 这就是我被雇来做的事，搬一堆箱子。

sentences.en: So I'm still doing the same thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在还在做同样的事。

sentences.en: But I am curious, though, how the Internet changed the way that reporters rely on and use the morgue and the clips here.
sentences.zh: 不过我很好奇，互联网是如何改变记者们对资料室以及这里剪报的依赖和使用方式的？

sentences.en: Oh, you know, it's pretty much, they don't use it much anymore.
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道的，基本上他们现在不怎么使用了。

sentences.en: Unless I will see that they're talking about something, and I'll say, well, you know, we got a bunch of clips on such and such.
sentences.zh: 除非我看到他们在讨论什么事情，然后我会说，嗯，你知道的，我们关于某某某有很多剪报。

sentences.en: And they'll take a look, and they'll be kind of amazed that we have this stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会看一看，并且会惊讶于我们竟然有这些东西。

sentences.en: It's used, but it's definitely not used like it was.
sentences.zh: 这里还在被使用，但绝对不如从前那样常用了。

sentences.en: But that's just the way it is.
sentences.zh: 不过这就是现实。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How do you find anything in here?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能在里头找到任何东西？

sentences.en: Like, if I want to find every clip about Angola, how do you know which box?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我想找到关于安哥拉的所有剪报，你怎么知道是哪个箱子？

sentences.en: Well, there's a box that has the Angola folder.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有个箱子里装着安哥拉的文件夹。

sentences.en: But how do you know where that box is?
sentences.zh: 但你怎么知道那个箱子在哪里？

sentences.en: Oh, well, I know where it is.
sentences.zh: 哦，这个嘛，我知道它在哪里。

sentences.en: I mean, it's up there.
sentences.zh: 我是说，它就在那上面。

sentences.en: But what happens if you go on vacation and somebody needs a box with Angola in it?
sentences.zh: 但如果你去度假了，而有人需要一个装有安哥拉资料的箱子，会发生什么？

sentences.en: They don't get it.
sentences.zh: 他们就拿不到了。

sentences.en: It's not like the paper closes down or something.
sentences.zh: 又不是说报纸要关门大吉什么的。

sentences.en: I guess I just want to understand, like, is there any kind of map in here?
sentences.zh: 我想我只是想弄明白，这里有什么样的地图吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it's pretty alphabetical to a certain extent.
sentences.zh: 有的，在某种程度上基本是按字母顺序排列的。

sentences.en: But it's kind of all over the place.
sentences.zh: 但也有点杂乱无章。

sentences.en: And yes, the problem there is that I'm kind of the one who knows where that is.
sentences.zh: 对，问题就在于，我基本上是唯一知道那些东西在哪里的人。

sentences.en: Like, you are, if I was doing an article about chimney sweepers.
sentences.zh: 就像你一样，如果我要写一篇关于烟囱清扫工的文章。

sentences.en: I think I do have, I think I pulled that folder.
sentences.zh: 我想我有的，我想我把那个文件夹抽出来了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Let me take a look.
sentences.zh: 让我看一看。

sentences.en: Let's, well, I got to move my, I got to take my this.
sentences.zh: 我们，呃，我得移动一下我的，我得拿走这个。

sentences.en: So I'm going to take the ladder.
sentences.zh: 所以我要去拿梯子。

sentences.en: I'll take the ladder here.
sentences.zh: 我把梯子拿过来。

sentences.en: Okay, so you're walking up to a one, two, three, four, five, six, eight row boxes and filing cabinets.
sentences.zh: 好的，你正走向一排、两排、三排、四排、五排、六排、八排的箱子和文件柜。

sentences.en: Jeff, if you pull that, is the whole thing going to come tumbling down?
sentences.zh: 杰夫，如果你拉那个，整堆东西不会塌下来吧？

sentences.en: Of course not.
sentences.zh: 当然不会。

sentences.en: All right, I think this box just have.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想这个箱子里只有——

sentences.en: So they have names.
sentences.zh: 所以它们有名字。

sentences.en: So, like, let's say here, this is the first box of churches, Baptists, so chimneys.
sentences.zh: 所以，比方说这里，这是第一箱教堂、浸信会，然后是烟囱。

sentences.en: I'm going to read some of the labels on some of these boxes while you're looking.
sentences.zh: 趁你在找的时候，我要读一读其中一些箱子上的标签。

sentences.en: Colleges, Columbia, clubs, atrocities to chronologies, etiquette to feuds.
sentences.zh: 高校、哥伦比亚大学、俱乐部、暴行到年表、礼仪到世仇。

sentences.en: So this is, these are obviously not subjects that have to do with one another.
sentences.zh: 所以这些，显然不是彼此相关的主题。

sentences.en: These are just alphabetized.
sentences.zh: 这些只是按字母顺序排列的。

sentences.en: Well, these were, I pulled a bunch of stuff that I thought was great to have.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这些是，我挑了一堆我觉得很棒的东西放在这里。

sentences.en: So if someone's doing stories on etiquette and doing stories on feuds, well, here's all the stories.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人在做关于礼仪或世仇的报道，看，所有的报道都在这儿。

sentences.en: So if you're doing a story on excommunications, well, here, June 1949 to 1958.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在做一个关于逐出教会的报道，喏，1949年6月到1958年。

sentences.en: Okay, I've got to read some of these others.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我还得读读其他一些。

sentences.en: Fiddlers to free enterprise.
sentences.zh: 提琴手到自由企业。

sentences.en: Free enterprise to gypsies.
sentences.zh: 自由企业到吉普赛人。

sentences.en: Habeas corpus to inflation.
sentences.zh: 人身保护令到通货膨胀。

sentences.en: We're looking for, we're on a mission for chimney sweepers.
sentences.zh: 我们在找，我们正在执行寻找烟囱清扫工的任务。

sentences.en: Chimney sweepers, yeah.
sentences.zh: 烟囱清扫工，对。

sentences.en: So let me see.
sentences.zh: 让我看看。

sentences.en: Can I read what this is?
sentences.zh: 我能读一下这是什么吗？

sentences.en: Okay, this one, this is a final cabinet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这个，这是最后一个文件柜。

sentences.en: It says Chinese New Year, churches, Episcopal Trinity.
sentences.zh: 上面写着中国农历新年、教堂、圣公会三一堂。

sentences.en: Yeah, so there's like, so there's, you know, here's the morbid folders like cadavers, May 1963.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这里有，你知道的，这里有像尸体这样病态的文件夹，1963年5月。

sentences.en: Cannibalism, 1940 to 51.
I'm going to look through this chimneys folder and see if there's anything on chimney sweepers.
sentences.zh: 我要翻翻这个烟囱文件夹，看看有没有关于扫烟囱工人的内容。

sentences.en: Yep, here we go.
sentences.zh: 行，我们来看看。

sentences.en: So I see the first article, what does it say?
sentences.zh: 我看到了第一篇文章，上面写的什么？

sentences.en: Yep, the first thing, the first thing.
sentences.zh: 对，就是第一篇，第一篇。

sentences.en: Oh, well, actually, no, you know what it says?
sentences.zh: 哦，其实，不对，你知道上面写的什么吗？

sentences.en: Chimney, chimney sweep demand is reaching a peak.
sentences.zh: 烟囱，烟囱清洁工的需求正在达到顶峰。

sentences.en: Okay, so presumably, oh, there's a picture of a chimney sweeper on this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以据推测，哦，上面有一张烟囱清洁工的照片。

sentences.en: So the very first article I pulled out is about chimney sweeping.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿出的第一篇文章是关于清理烟囱的。

sentences.en: So if you were before.
sentences.zh: 如果你以前的话。

sentences.en: From, from, wait, it's November 3rd, 1985.
sentences.zh: 从，从，等等，那是1985年11月3日。

sentences.en: Can you describe, Jeff, what this was like when you first started?
sentences.zh: 杰夫，你能描述一下你刚开始工作时这里是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: And maybe even take us back to your first day, if you remember it.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以带我们回到你的第一天，如果你还记得的话。

sentences.en: Yes, so what was it like when I first started?
sentences.zh: 好的，那我刚开始的时候是什么样的？

sentences.en: It was in the old building, the third floor.
sentences.zh: 是在老建筑的三楼。

sentences.en: The old building was?
sentences.zh: 老建筑是？

sentences.en: Was on 229 West 43rd Street.

sentences.en: And so we, the Times was in that building around the corner from Times Square from, it was called the Times Annex.
